scripts.check: npm run check:brand && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build
scripts.check:cloudflare: wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.prelive.jsonc && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.jsonc && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.www.jsonc
scripts.deploy:prelive: wrangler deploy --config wrangler.prelive.jsonc --var RELEASE_SHA:$(git rev-parse HEAD)
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: wrangler deploy --config wrangler.jsonc --var RELEASE_SHA:$(git rev-parse HEAD)
scripts.deploy:production: npm run deploy:cloudflare && npm run deploy:www
